summary: Two complementary lists give the same overlap table for three sensor outputs. Moving between the lists changes the probe weights, but the best error stays positive and constant.
summary_zh: 两张互补清单给三个传感器输出同一张重叠表。混合的比例改变了探针权重，却没有改变正的最小错误率。
title: Why the average does not improve
